prayer.text: Father, thank You for speaking clearly in Exodus 20:22-26. In this passage You bring commandment-shaped obedience under holy authority into the open through In every place where I cause My name to be remembered. Lord, keep us from reading these words as distant history only, and press them into our ordinary obedience today. Where we resist the truth highlighted in this reflection, bring repentance and renewed trust. Keep us near Your word, and do not let ordinary pressure turn us away from humble obedience. Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Exodus 20:22-26 opens with a scene marked by commandment-shaped obedience under holy authority. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from commandment-shaped obedience instead of selective morality. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue concrete obedience shaped by God's holy commands. Amen.
